purpose.zh: 上背靠在椅子上，练屁股
purpose.en: Builds your butt with your upper back on a chair.

text.zh: 脚后跟踩地把胯往上推，顶上夹紧屁股
text.en: Push through your heels to drive your hips up, squeeze your butt at the top

text.zh: 上背靠在结实椅子的边上，两脚跟胯一样宽，手放在胯上。
text.en: Upper back on the edge of a sturdy chair, feet hip-width, hands on your hips.

text.zh: 顶上大腿和身子一条线，小腿竖直。
text.en: At the top, thighs and body in one line, shins upright.

commonErrors.zh: 顶到最高还往上挺，腰拱成桥
commonErrors.en: Pushing past straight so your back arches into a bridge.

commonErrors.zh: 往上顶时膝盖往中间夹
commonErrors.en: Knees falling together as you drive up.

cautions.en: Make sure the chair is sturdy and won't slide.

cautions.zh: 腰疼就推低点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your lower back hurts, don't drive as high. Stop if it still hurts.
